messages:
Rowan: Quick design check  Starter Repos drawer we plan to show on first run. Need CTA copy, a11y, and keyboard flow review. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/starter-repos
Ivy: Scanning. Two quick things: the primary CTA text feels verbose and thumbnails lack descriptive alt text.
Marcus: For CTAs I tried variants: 'Open starter', 'Explore starter repo', 'Use starter template'. I prefer 'Explore starter repo'  clear and discovery-focused.
Claire: Agree but prefer shorter when space is tight. Could we truncate to 'Explore repo' on small screens? Also add ellipsis to indicate more content.
Rowan: Good call. Also accessibility: thumbnails currently read as 'image' with no label. Should be 'Starter: Support bot repo' etc. We'll add aria-labels and aria-describedby linking to the short description.
Ivy: Contrast check: the subtle secondary link color (#4BA1FF) on white at 13px is ~3.0:1. Recommend #0B61B8 or bump weight to semibold.
Marcus: Keyboard flow issue: when drawer opens pressing Tab focuses the close icon first. Users miss the primary action. Suggested fix: set focus to the first repo card CTAs programmatically and ensure focus-visible style.
Claire: Agree. Also add a sr-only heading 'Starter repos' for screen readers announcing the drawer content.
Rowan: UX copy decision: we'll use 'Explore starter repo' desktop, 'Explore repo' mobile. Ivy, can you update the figma frames and add the color swap?
Ivy: Will do. Also adding a small 'Don't show again' checkbox remembered in account prefs (event: onboarding_hide_starter_repos). Need copy for tooltip: 'Hide starter repos on future visits'.
Marcus: For keyboard focus I can implement focus trap and call focus() on the first CTA after open. Also adding CSS:

.drawer-cta:focus { outline: 3px solid #ffd34d; }
.drawer-thumbnail[aria-hidden="false"] { border-radius: 6px; }

will push later today.

onboard-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview.example.com/starter-repos-drawer (branch: starter-repos-a11y)
Claire: Reviewed preview  contrast and focus good. One nit: mobile spacing between title and meta is 6px but spec is 8px. Small spacing tweak then merge.
Rowan: Thanks all. After spacing patch we'll merge and A/B test 'Explore starter repo' vs 'Use starter template' for first-click conversion. :tada:
